site.name: Ada Bell Mine
site.location: Lisbon Gap area near the Colorado–Utah border, San Miguel County
overview: Ada Bell Mine is a mapped historic uranium-and-vanadium mine in western San Miguel County near the Colorado–Utah border. The site lies in the Colorado Plateau's Uravan mining region rather than the mountain districts around Telluride.

timeline.text: USGS Mineral Resources Data System record 10119394 identifies the Ada Bell property and lists uranium and vanadium as its commodities.
The Ada Bell Mine remains a named feature on the USGS Lisbon Gap 7.5-minute topographic quadrangle.

moreHistory: The mapped locality provides a defensible site-level identification point. It does not confirm which mine opening or surface feature survives today, and present ownership, access, and ground conditions should be checked locally before any visit.
